notebook: PLAN: Final optimization of the proven three-column C4/C5-blend plant. Restore the convergent best root unchanged and test only modest child-column stage/reflux reductions; stop after this last economic comparison. Best valid 0.360: root 60/4/6, T 60/5/10, TT 40/3/4; revenue 627.5M, cost 469.7M; TB 97% C5 and TTB about 99% C4. Turn 27's larger cuts saved only 42M but lost the 459M C5 product. Turn 28 failed at the modified root 55/3.8/6, so do not alter root again. Current children retain full boil-up and have 2% purity headroom, making them the safest final cost-saving candidates. TTT is unsellable and not worth another column.
